player_intent: Mantle short edges, vault with AGLS motion, jump higher with a running start and pass through open windows when timed correctly.
acceptance_rule: Grounded Jump at a supported edge up to 1.35 m starts low mantle without hanging. Higher edges retain hang-first controls. Full forward input with at least 4.5 m/s actual speed selects a 7 m/s launch; otherwise preserve the 5 m/s hop. Launch speed survives replay and proxy presentation. Real open-window fixtures accept timed jumps; solid panes and late sill contact remain blocking. AGLS poses are presentation only. Warehouse uses mesh collision in both saved map copies.

nodes.role: Selects contextual movement and applies collision

must_not_change: Collision cannot be bypassed for windows
visual_check: Render low mantle and vault early/mid/late. Source one-meter motion is adapted, not contact IK. Exact hand-to-edge matching and arbitrary rock/awning eligibility still require map-specific checks.

system_delta.reason: Extend existing motor/controller instead of scaling the world or adding root-motion authority. Short grounded edges bypass inappropriate hang; movement launch remains deterministic. Mesh collision replaces warehouse bounding box that hid the visible awning edge.

current.system: Hang-first at every height and one jump impulse
